units.source_text: 源氏公子问道：“那么那个女儿怎么样？”

en.t: Prince Genji asked, "Then what is that daughter like?"

units.source_text: 良清说：“相貌和品质都不坏。

en.t: Yoshikiyo said, "Her looks and character are both quite good.

units.source_text: 每一任国守都特别看中她，郑重地向她父亲求婚。

en.t: Every provincial governor has thought highly of her and has formally asked her father for her hand.

units.source_text: 可是这父亲概不允诺，他常常提起他的遗言，

en.t: But her father refuses them all, and he often brings up the dead man's last words,

units.source_text: 说：‘我身一事无成，从此沉沦了。

en.t: saying, 'I have accomplished nothing in my life, and from now on I am sinking into obscurity.

units.source_text: 所希望者，只此一个女儿，但愿她将来发迹。

en.t: My only hope is this one daughter; may she rise in the world someday.

units.source_text: 万一此志不遂，我身先死了，

en.t: If this wish should fail, and I die before it is fulfilled,

units.source_text: 而她盼不到发迹的机缘，还不如投身入海吧。’”

en.t: and she cannot find any chance to rise, she may as well throw herself into the sea.'"

units.source_text: 源氏公子听了这话颇感兴味。

en.t: Prince Genji found these words rather intriguing.

units.source_text: 随从者笑道：“这个女儿真是宝贝，

en.t: The attendants laughed and said, "That daughter must be a real treasure,

units.source_text: 要她当海龙王的王后，志气太高了！”

en.t: if they mean to make her queen of the Dragon King of the Sea. What lofty ambitions!"

units.source_text: 报告这件事的良清，是现任播磨守的儿子，

en.t: Yoshikiyo, who reported this affair, was the son of the current Governor of Harima,

units.source_text: 今年已由六位藏人晋爵为五位了。

en.t: and this year he had already been promoted from a sixth-rank chamberlain to the fifth rank.

units.source_text: 他的朋辈议论道：“这良清真是个好色之徒，

en.t: His companions remarked, "This Yoshikiyo is quite the woman-chaser.

units.source_text: 他打算破坏那和尚的遗言，将这女儿娶作妻子，

en.t: He means to break that monk's last command and take the daughter as his wife,

units.source_text: 所以常去窥探那家情况。”

en.t: so he is always going there to pry into that household's affairs."

units.source_text: 有一人说：“哼，说得这么好，

en.t: Someone said, "Hmph, however splendidly he talks her up,

units.source_text: 其实恐怕是个乡下姑娘吧！

en.t: in truth she is probably just a country girl!

units.source_text: 从小生长在这种小地方，由这么古板的父母教养长大，

en.t: Growing up from childhood in a little place like that, raised by such old-fashioned parents,

units.source_text: 可想而知了！”

en.t: one can easily imagine what she must be like!"

units.source_text: 良清说：“哪里！

en.t: Yoshikiyo said, "Not at all!

units.source_text: 她母亲是个有来历的人，交游极广，

en.t: Her mother is a woman of good background and has very wide connections.

units.source_text: 向京城各富贵之家雇来许多容貌姣好的青年侍女和女童，

en.t: She has hired many handsome young maids and girl attendants from wealthy houses in the capital,

units.source_text: 教女儿学习礼仪，排场阔绰得很呢。”

en.t: and has them teach her daughter proper manners. Their household is run in very grand style."

units.source_text: 也有人说：“不过，倘使双亲死了，

en.t: Another person said, "Still, if both her parents were to die,

units.source_text: 变成孤儿，怕不能再享福了吧。”

en.t: she would become an orphan and probably could not go on enjoying such fortune."

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“究竟有什么心计，

en.t: Prince Genji said, "What scheme could she possibly have in mind,

units.source_text: 因而想到海底去呢？

en.t: that would make her think of going to the bottom of the sea?

units.source_text: 海底长着水藻，风景并不好看呢。”

en.t: Seaweed grows down there, and the scenery is not especially pleasant."

units.source_text: 看来他对这件事很关心。

en.t: It seemed that he was very interested in the matter.

units.source_text: 随从人便体察到公子的心情，

en.t: The attendants then sensed the prince's feelings,

units.source_text: 他们想：“虽然只是一个乡下姑娘，

en.t: and they thought, "Although she is only a country girl,

units.source_text: 但我们这位公子偏好乖僻的事情，

en.t: our prince has a taste for unusual things,

units.source_text: 所以用心听在耳朵里了。”

en.t: so he has listened carefully and taken this to heart."
